name: live_dialogue_pause_long
description: The host's clock runs (coop clock on). A host script starts a conversation with Doc Mitchell, and the host's menu holds it open for 40 s with no pick after the first line. The host's conversation stops everyone's time for one dialogue heartbeat (15 s, GameState::coop_conversation_stops_time). Then the world clock runs on under the open menu. The guest watches the whole hold: its frames run, its clock stood still for no more than the heartbeat plus a tolerance, and its clock ran for at least 15 s of the hold.
